title: Issue #195: Integrate ATC-CHILD-SAFETY-POLICY-001 across canonical components
content:
State: open

## Ecosystem-Integration: ATC-CHILD-SAFETY-POLICY-001

**Normative intake:** https://github.com/A-TownChain-Okosystems/atc-standards/issues/114  
**Status:** `BLOCKED` until the normative standard is approved and registered.

### Purpose
Track ecosystem-level ownership, dependency mapping, implementation coverage and evidence for the child-safety policy. This issue does not create a second normative SSOT or implement component behavior in the umbrella repository.

### Required work
- [ ] Link the approved standard and exact registry version once governance approval is recorded.
- [ ] Map requirements CS-001..CS-008 (or their approved final IDs) to canonical repositories, exact paths/symbols and owning teams.
- [ ] Identify applicable runtime enforcement boundaries for GlobusOS/ShivaCore, Aurora AI/Runtime, Wallet, A-TownChain/ATC-VM, apps and communication services.
- [ ] Reconcile component inventory against the organization repository manifest; do not infer completeness from search results alone.
- [ ] Record each requirement as `MAPPED`, `IMPLEMENTED`, `VERIFIED`, `RESIDUAL`, `BLOCKED` or justified `EXCLUDED`.
- [ ] Attach reproducible evidence bound to full commit SHA, workflow run/job/step, exit code/logs and artifact hashes.
- [ ] Keep unverified critical controls `BLOCKED`; no production-readiness claim from documentation or green CI alone.

### SSOT boundary
`atc-standards` owns normative policy. This repository owns integration mapping, cross-repository dependencies and evidence aggregation only. Kernel, VM, wallet and agent implementations remain in their canonical source repositories.

### Acceptance
A complete requirement-to-source mapping, no unexplained unresolved edges, approved normative source link, and evidence-based status per control.
